root_cause: Required preflight intentionally uses shallow history. material-writeback-closure-guard derived changed paths with git diff base...head, which requires a merge base. When the immutable base was fetched as a separate shallow object, both commit trees existed but merge-base discovery failed before closure semantics could run.

prevention.changed_path_authority: Compare the exact base and head commit trees with git diff --name-only <base> <head>.

evidence.failure: git diff --name-only <base>...<head> could not resolve a merge base in shallow preflight
